instruction: Candid wedding photograph, full-length shot. In an outdoor paved courtyard with a vine-covered archway, the groom in a beige suit (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing left with hands clasped. The bride in a white wedding dress (R1) stands on the right, facing away from the camera, placing her hand on his shoulder. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows on the stone pavement.
